description: Conducción Acueducto. Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Empresa de Acueducto y Alcantarillado de Bogotá ESP - EAAB. Red encargada de transportar el agua potable desde la Planta de Tratamiento de Agua Potable (PTAP), hasta los tanques de almacenamiento. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Empresa de Acueducto y Alcantarillado de Bogotá ESP - EAAB. Its tags are Agua, Almacenamiento, Conducción, EAAB, Planta. It offers 1 resource(s) in ESRI REST. The portal shows 2024-06-19 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
